newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Feb 3.

text.p: * Apple Computer Inc is expected to announce as early as today its second restructuring in a year. The plan will involve job cuts affecting up to a quarter of its 13,000 workforce, a source close to Apple said. The company is also mulling options for unprofitable lines like its Newton handheld computer. Shares closed on Friday at 16-5/8.

* Nu Skin Asia Pacific said it is remains comfortable with analysts' 1996 earnings estimates. The average estimate on Nu Skin for 1996 is $0.91 per share, according to First Call. Shares closed at 25-7/8.

* Scotsman Industries Inc agreed to acquire most of Kysor Industrial Corp for about $300 million, the Wall Street Journal reported. According to the report, Scotsman will offer $43 for each Kysor common and preferred share.

Kysor is also expected to sell its transportation product group's assets to Kuhlman Corp for $86 million plus debt assumption, the paper said. Kysor closed at 37, Scotsman closed at 24 and Kuhlman closed at 17-3/4.

* ITT Corp's chairman has rejected an offer to meet with the top executive of Hilton Hotels Corp sources close to the companies said. Hilton last week launched a $6.5 billion hostile takeover bid for ITT. Hilton closed at 28-1/2 and ITT closed at 57-1/4.
